page_title: BOC 3-2 BAY | Bochum v Bayern Munich 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.

90+7' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Manuel Riemann makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
90+6' The resulting corner from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the defence.

90+6' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noah Loosli (Bochum) is coming onto the pitch as Anthony Losilla cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+5' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

90+4' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. Bochum win a corner.
90+4' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

90+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Manuel Riemann makes a comfortable save.
90+2' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Takuma Asano makes way for Philipp Forster (Bochum).
87' 3 - 2 Goal! Mathys Tel puts the ball across the area and Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 3:2.
86' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.

86' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Manuel Riemann makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
85' A great solo run by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Manuel Riemann.
83' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
82' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Kevin Stoger (Bochum). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
80' Bochum are ruled offside.
79' The substitution has been made. Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) has replaced Christopher Antwi-Adjei.
79' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) replacing Raphael Guerreiro.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch so that Thomas Muller can be given a rest.
78' 3 - 1 Goal! Manuel Neuer gets a hand on the penalty from Kevin Stoger (Bochum), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
78' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
77' The game is help up as Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) is shown a red card, following two cautions, and has to leave the pitch.

77' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Schlager no option but to blow his whistle. Bochum are given a penalty!
76' The ball is out of play. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner.
76' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
75' 9:17 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:5.

72' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) inside the box. He lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Manuel Neuer was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
70' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Leroy Sane. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
67' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.

65' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Manuel Riemann, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
65' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

64' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
63' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Joshua Kimmich and he is replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich).
63' Substitution. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich).
62' The flag is raised and Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) is offside again, not for the first time today.
61' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
60' The attendance is 26000.
59' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
59' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

59' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
57' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
56' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
54' The game is interrupted.
53' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
52' The ball is cleared after Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
49' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) sends a long ball in, but Manuel Riemann comfortably gathers the ball.
48' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting.
46' Takuma Asano (Bochum) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Thomas Letsch probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Tim Oermann (Bochum). He is replaced by Cristian Gamboa.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+14' Daniel Schlager has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+14' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.
45+13' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
45+12' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

45+11' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Moritz Broschinski is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him.
45+8' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Manuel Riemann comes off his line to gather the ball.

45+6' The free kick from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.

45+6' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Schlager and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. Anthony Losilla (Bochum) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
45+3' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+3' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly wide of the left post. Unlucky finish.
45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45' 14 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The referee shows the yellow card to Bernardo (Bochum).
44' 2 - 1 Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:1.
44' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) prepares to take a corner kick.

43' Takuma Asano (Bochum) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Bochum have a corner.
39' It's like he was asking for a caution. Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card.

38' 1 - 1 Brilliant finish! Takuma Asano (Bochum) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Anthony Losilla, then produced a nice strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
34' Kevin Stoger sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Moritz Broschinski (Bochum), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
34' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
33' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch because Noussair Mazraoui simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
32' The match can continue after the interruption.
21' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
20' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.

19' Ambitious effort from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
17' Leon Goretzka passes to Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
14' 0 - 1 Goal Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich)! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) was put through by Leon Goretzka and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top of the net. 0:1.

14' Nice individual effort by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Manuel Riemann does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
14' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the right side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
14' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will deliver the corner kick.
13' The corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is hurriedly cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
12' A cross from Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

10' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Manuel Riemann is alert and denies him with a nice save.
9' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
8' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
6' Kevin Stoger swings the cross over. Anthony Losilla (Bochum) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.

5' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Takuma Asano was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) brings an opponent down and Daniel Schlager interrupts the game.
2' Tim Oermann (Bochum) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Neuer intercepts the ball.
2' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager will supervise the game today.
